metadata.scope: Public official evidence acquired to reduce responsibility-index gaps
metadata.truth_policy: A public source may support a candidate or a factual source claim. It must not be promoted to verified asset ownership, current district SOP, or dispatch authorization without the required agency-issued evidence.

sources.publisher_th: กองสารสนเทศภูมิศาสตร์ กรุงเทพมหานคร
sources.notes: Resolves an exact public item, proxy URL, upstream URL, and item timestamp. It cannot prove that the checked-in canals.geojson is an immutable export of this item because the service query was unavailable and no upstream export hash was published.
